reviews.decision: The current owned suffix.ts has no direct import, reexport, import-type or dynamic route to @angular/material/form-field; its provider instead uses locally owned MAT_LEGACY_SUFFIX under the local alias MAT_SUFFIX. The untouched Material 16 legacy source used the peer token, so this is a real identity change and not an inherited peer use. Angular DI, query, rendering and mixed-generation behavior remain separate.

reviews.decision: The named @angular/cdk/table HeaderRowOutlet identifier is absent from the current owned table-module source; that file still imports the public CdkTableModule. Material 16 legacy table-module likewise imported CdkTableModule, while the installed 22.1.7 outlet class is marked docs-private. Current owned table template uses a local outlet bridge whose explicitly excepted CdkTable underscore hooks remain real peer implementation dependencies. This removed direct source use grants no table rendering, provider, native, packed or runtime equivalence.

prior_complete_case.decision: The frozen HeaderRowOutlet occurrence at legacy-table/table-module.ts is removed from the maintained source. The only executable reference was a redundant NgModule imports entry; the existing public CdkTableModule import already exports the identical outlet class binding, with complete exact minimum declaration/runtime export metadata independently inspected. No selector, template, provider, table parent, row/outlet implementation or style behavior changes. The public module retains the outlet directive scope on both actual minimum versions. Close this obsolete direct private binding only; runtime/template/AOT/packed and all other table/DI/manual-constructor obligations remain separate. Subsequent table outlet ownership repair changes only inert outlet bindings and their internal protocol; the historical unchanged-emit statement above belongs to its original captured subject. The unused direct outlet imports remain absent on this source. Fresh tagged outlet/section/ownership execution, both minimum declaration proofs and genuine public-parent diagnostics support the current binding; native/packed and original table manual construction remain unqualified. Fresh complete AST inspection renews the module source cap after the definition-owner wiring repair: all four direct retired outlet bindings remain absent, and the root public CdkTableModule binding remains in NgModule imports. Reintroducing each retired class into either module or table source rejects (eight controls). The earlier original-removal emit identity remains scoped to its recorded subject; current template/table behavior stays a separate audit obligation. Scoped current-source requalification: the column/cell repair keeps all prior class/parameter decorators and constructor arguments. Sticky code is unchanged; the module adds only one private bridge declaration/export/import. Former private CDK class-array/name hooks are removed. Public name/cssClassFriendlyName and complete actual owned/current parent construction preserve authentic16 final classes in 288 native comparison cases. The bridge is manually constructed; actual node/module/packed integration is deferred. No full node/factory/packed/floor scope is added.
